cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

mechanism: A grants reciprocal disclosure only after B goes first, controlling the order of emotional exposure while needing an admission of longing.
confusable: D80 seeks a risky trust act generally; D88 specifically withholds A own attachment until B admits theirs.
comparison: A return to the flat and key sounds differ from a sale chair and kept cushion.
seedUse: Use D88-a explicit you-first and B every-evening answer; preserve the sequence before A own admission.
